items: UPS announces 5.9% average rate increase. Effective Dec. 21, 2026, Retail Rates for Ground, Air and International services and all Ground Saver rates rise an average net 5.9%. The minimum billable weight for Additional Handling also moves from 40 lbs. to 50 lbs.

UPS Ground Saver 1 lb+ rates rise across table. Under a 2027 rate card effective Dec. 21, 2026, a 1 lb zone 2 package goes from $13.00 to $13.65, and a 70 lb zone 8 package from $140.23 to $150.12. Delivery area and remote surcharges also rise.

SpeedX sets 5% average rate increase. The company announced on Nov. 18 a general rate increase averaging 5% on base transportation rates for shipments tendered on or after Jan. 16, 2027. Account managers will provide updated rate cards by Dec. 15, 2026.
